scope: For each p<q<r and all nonzero constants c_i in C and exponent vectors m_i in Z^4, no sum c_p U^m_p alpha^p + c_q U^m_q alpha^q + c_r U^m_r alpha^r lies on the H=11:5 trace cubic after the R2 normalization.
strict_nonclaims: No coordinate is allowed to be a sum of two or more Laurent monomials.
No arbitrary rational-function coordinate is treated.
No K-rational point or pointlessness theorem for a whole plane cubic is proved.
No K-rational point or pointlessness theorem for the ambient twist is proved.
